instruction: Candid outdoor medium shot of a couple on a snowy wooden bridge. On the left, the man in the black parka (R1) walks forward, looking at his partner with a smile. On the right, the woman in the brown jacket (R2) walks beside him, looking forward and smiling happily. They hold hands as they walk. Soft, diffused daylight illuminates the cool winter forest setting.
